title: The Master’s Workshop
brief: Hoo! Let’s step into the Middle Ages. Most children did not go to school. Many became apprentices. Build a master’s workshop, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is a shoemaker’s workshop in a medieval town. An apprentice worked for a master craftsman for several years, learning every part of the job.

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your four models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **workbench** by a building. Put the **anvil**, **hammer** and **candle** on or by the bench.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “An apprentice learns a trade by ___. In this shop, my job would be ___.”
steps.text: Stand by the bench and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Stand by the bench and say this out loud. An apprentice learns a trade by… In this shop, my job would be…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the workbench, the anvil, the hammer and the candle

extra.text: Add a **Wooden Barrel**. Say what the master might keep in it.

points: Your photo shows the workbench, the anvil, the hammer and the candle.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read what each worker says and tap the job. Then finish two sentences about apprentices.
mapday.done: ✓ You matched every job. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: A medieval town street with a spot for each worker

clues.q: “I shape hot iron with my hammer.”
“I bake bread in a big oven.”
“I build tables and doors out of wood.”
“I feed the horses at first light.”
